description: One call returns current gas price and priority fee on every supported chain plus the Solana priority-fee median, ranked from cheapest to most expensive. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: multi_chain_gas
